commands.cmd:
python3 -c "
import glob, hashlib, json, tomllib, urllib.request
c = 'fastapi'
stack = [x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id'] == c]
winners = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == c})
print('manifests/stack.json fastapi version:', stack)
print('catalogs/landscape winner pins for fastapi:', winners)
assert stack == ['0.141.1'], ('stack pin mismatch', stack)
assert winners == ['0.141.1'], ('winner pin mismatch', winners)
lock = tomllib.load(open('blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/uv.lock', 'rb'))
pkgs = {p['name']: p for p in lock['package']}
for name, want_version in (('fastapi', '0.141.1'), ('uvicorn', '0.53.0')):
    p = pkgs[name]
    assert p['version'] == want_version, (name, 'lock version mismatch', p['version'])
    w = p['wheels'][0]
    lock_hash = w['hash'].removeprefix('sha256:')
    data = urllib.request.urlopen(w['url'], timeout=30).read()
    got_hash = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    print(name, p['version'], 'uv.lock sha256', lock_hash, 'downloaded wheel sha256', got_hash, 'match', got_hash == lock_hash)
    assert got_hash == lock_hash, (name, 'wheel hash mismatch: uv.lock says', lock_hash, 'downloaded', got_hash)
print('fastapi 0.141.1 and uvicorn 0.53.0 wheel bytes match blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/uv.lock exactly; both pins match manifests/stack.json and the catalogs/landscape winner pin')
"

commands.cmd:
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
PORT=$(python3 -c "import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
print(s.getsockname()[1])
s.close()") || exit 1
cd blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery || exit 1
DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:1/unused' PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with fastapi==0.141.1 --with uvicorn==0.53.0 --with 'psycopg[binary]==3.3.6' --with pydantic==2.13.5 --with starlette==1.6.0 --with annotated-doc==0.0.5 --with typing-extensions==4.16.0 --with typing-inspection==0.4.4 --with click==8.5.0 --with h11==0.16.0 -- uvicorn backend.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --app-dir . > "$D/server.log" 2>&1 &
SPID=$!
i=0
ready=0
while [ $i -lt 90 ]; do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 3 -o "$D/schema.json" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/openapi.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$ready" != "1" ]; then
  echo "server did not become ready within budget"
  cat "$D/server.log"
  fuser -k -TERM "$PORT"/tcp 2>/dev/null
  kill "$SPID" 2>/dev/null
  rm -rf "$D"
  exit 1
fi
code_empty=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/empty.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/runs" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title": ""}')
code_extra=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/extra.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/runs" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title": "ok", "admin": true}')
code_uuid=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/uuid.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X PATCH "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/runs/not-a-uuid" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"status": "passed", "expected_revision": 1}')
code_docs=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/docs")
fuser -k -TERM "$PORT"/tcp 2>/dev/null
kill "$SPID" 2>/dev/null
wait "$SPID" 2>/dev/null
j=0
stopped=0
while [ $j -lt 10 ]; do
  if ! curl -fsS --max-time 1 -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/openapi.json" 2>/dev/null; then stopped=1; break; fi
  j=$((j + 1))
  sleep 0.5
done
python3 -c "
import json, sys
d, ce, cx, cu, cd, stopped = sys.argv[1:7]
schema = json.load(open(d + '/schema.json'))
committed = json.load(open('openapi.json'))
empty = json.load(open(d + '/empty.json'))
extra = json.load(open(d + '/extra.json'))
badid = json.load(open(d + '/uuid.json'))
run_create = schema['components']['schemas']['RunCreate']
run_status = schema['components']['schemas']['RunStatus']
title_field = run_create['properties']['title']
checks = {
    'live /openapi.json == checked-in openapi.json': schema == committed,
    'RunCreate.title minLength 1 maxLength 120': title_field.get('minLength') == 1 and title_field.get('maxLength') == 120,
    'RunCreate forbids extra properties': run_create.get('additionalProperties') is False,
    'RunStatus enum matches app.py': run_status.get('enum') == ['planned', 'running', 'passed', 'failed'],
    'POST empty title -> 422': ce == '422',
    'POST extra field admin -> 422': cx == '422',
    'PATCH invalid uuid path -> 422': cu == '422',
    'GET /docs -> 200': cd == '200',
    'empty-title error names field title': any('title' in str(item.get('loc')) for item in empty.get('detail', [])),
    'extra-field error type extra_forbidden': any(item.get('type') == 'extra_forbidden' for item in extra.get('detail', [])),
    'invalid-uuid error type mentions uuid': any('uuid' in str(item.get('type', '')) for item in badid.get('detail', [])),
    'server no longer accepting connections after stop': stopped == '1',
}
for k, v in checks.items():
    print(('PASS' if v else 'FAIL'), '-', k)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(checks.values()) else 1)
" "$D" "$code_empty" "$code_extra" "$code_uuid" "$code_docs" "$stopped"
result=$?
rm -rf "$D"
exit $result
